4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that respond- ent No.2 appeared in 9th class only for three days but he deposited the fee for whole of the year and it was deposited inadvertently.
On account of aforesaid, respondent No.2 also deposited the fee of 10th class for four months.
It is also urged that allegation against the present applicant is that re- spondent No.2 studied in applicant's school but mark-sheet was provided to him of some another school.
It is also urged that applicant has refunded the fee Rs.12,000/- to the respondent No.2.

On above grounds, it fence under Sections 420, 120-B and 471 of IPC be quashed.

It is also urged that mark-sheet provided by the applicant is fake and forged one.
FIR has been rightly registered against applicant.
Hence, petition filed by the petitioner be dismissed.
